name: update_exact
patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.txt
@@
 one
-two
+TWO
 three
*** End Patch

name: update_context
patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.txt
@@
 alpha
-beta
+BETA
*** End Patch

name: update_append_at_eof
patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.txt
@@
 two
+three
*** End Patch

name: add_file
patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: b.txt
+hello
+world
*** End Patch

contract.reason: New text files end with a newline, avoiding concatenated shell output.

name: delete_file
patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: a.txt
*** End Patch

name: move_file
patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.txt
*** Move to: c.txt
@@
-content
+content
*** End Patch

contract.reason: The engine advertises strict Add/Update/Delete sections, not Move to; unsupported directives must fail before mutation.

name: bom_preserved
patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.txt
@@
-one
+ONE
*** End Patch

name: multi_file
patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.txt
@@
-x
+y
*** Add File: b.txt
+new
*** End Patch

contract.reason: New text files end with a newline.

name: update_multiple_hunks
patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.txt
@@
-one
+ONE
@@
-four
+FOUR
*** End Patch

name: update_no_trailing_newline
patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.txt
@@
-two
+TWO
*** End Patch

contract.reason: Updates preserve the original final-newline convention rather than changing unrelated bytes.
